tools.name: bid_featured
tools.description: Take the Featured spot. It sits above every listing. The minimum right now is $51. Always dofollow. One-time payment, no refund when someone outbids you. The product must already be listed. Omit amount_usd to bid $51.

tools.name: read_featured
tools.description: Who holds the Featured spot, and the current minimum bid.

tools.name: submit_listing
tools.description: List a product. It goes live immediately. One listing per root domain. https://yourapp.com is the documentation placeholder and is refused.

tools.name: upgrade_listing
tools.description: Checkout URL for a paid tier on a listing that already exists.

tools.name: refresh_listing
tools.description: Re-read title, description, and image from the listed page. Send listing_id and proof only. The first confirm previews; send apply back to save.

tools.name: change_listing_url
tools.description: Point an existing listing at a new URL. One listing per root domain, so this is how a second page replaces the first.

tools.name: set_tracking_params
tools.description: Set the tracking params on a paid listing's outbound link (Bronze and up). Keys: ref or utm_* (<=10, lowercase/digits/_); values: 1-100 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ ~ -. Send {} to clear back to ?ref=curlship. Free listings are refused.

tools.name: remove_free_listing
tools.description: Take a free listing off the directory. Send remove true and no url or email. A paid listing or the Featured holder is refused.

tools.name: confirm_edit
tools.description: Apply an edit request. A refresh needs a second call with the apply digest from the preview.

tools.name: verify_badge
tools.description: Re-check the listed site for a link to curlship.com. A free listing with the badge becomes dofollow.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The category tree with a listing count per category — a group slug like developer-tools, plus any promoted leaf categories under it. Each listing's category field carries one of these slugs.

tools.name: list_listings
tools.description: Active listings as JSON. No query returns every listing, in the same order as before. Optional query parameters: limit, offset, q, since, and category. q matches the title, description, or URL. since is an ISO timestamp; listings created at or after it are kept. category is a category slug and filte

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Listing counts and the Ahrefs Domain Rating.

tools.name: get_daily_stats
tools.description: Active listings added per UTC day — the zero-filled series behind the public /stats page. One entry per calendar day from the first listing to today, each with added and the cumulative running total.

tools.name: get_dr_history
tools.description: The site's Ahrefs Domain Rating over time — the series behind /stats#dr. Every recorded reading, one per UTC day, plus the current value, the last step (change vs the most recent different reading) and the growth since the first reading.

tools.name: x402_submit_listing
tools.description: Buy bronze_lifetime ($30 USDC once, forever) or platinum ($49 USDC per prepaid year) with USDC over x402 — settled on-chain, no checkout page, no human in the loop. Call without payment_signature and the reply is a 402 whose body (also the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, base64) is the quote; sign accepts[

tools.name: x402_bid_featured
tools.description: Bid on the Featured spot in USDC over x402 — the same auction as a card bid (minimum $51 right now), but settled on-chain with no checkout and no human in the loop. Call without payment_signature for the 402 quote, sign accepts[0] as an EIP-3009 authorization, call again with payment_signature echoi

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "x402_submit_listing" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_listings · Public sink: submit_listing, refresh_listing, set_tracking_params, remove_free_listing, x402_submit_listing · Destructive: remove_free_listing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_listings · Public sink: submit_listing, refresh_listing, set_tracking_params, remove_free_listing, x402_submit_listing · Destructive: remove_free_listing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
